description: Spellings AI and human authors were measured writing (run_bench mine) for model objects whose canonical shape differs. ONE table, read by npdev_desire_paths (rewrites the model) and npdev_validation_hints (adds a 'did you mean' hint to a validator diagnostic). Add an alias here, never in either module.

objects.label: rollup
objects.note: field = the stored field on THIS concept that holds the result; from = the child concept; via = the child's reference field pointing back here; of = the child field aggregated (omit for count).

objects.label: orchestration action
objects.note: map holds the values to write, keyed by target field.

objects.label: field type
objects.note: Allowed: string, uuid, int, integer, long, decimal, boolean, date, datetime, enum, reference, object, array, file.
